args.lesson: Bounded stop after 3 of 5 FETCHes. The HN November 2026 freelancer thread (50338744) had 14 top-level posts on 2026-11-09, and all 14 were SEEKING WORK. None was SEEKING FREELANCER. What worked: searching Algolia by exact title with attributesToRetrieve found the current thread in one FETCH. A whoishiring search returned a stale 2025 story. What failed: the premise. Public freelancer threads are dominated by sellers, like the n8n Jobs for-hire posts. Across n8n, OSM, Ghost, Posit, WordPress, r/forhire and HN, we found no buyer who posts a scoped, offline, email-invited task. Next time, before any further channel scan, count buyer posts versus seller posts in one FETCH and stop when buyer posts are 0. The paid acceptance and outreach dependencies still bind.
